snippet.title: FantasyJourney - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Fantasy Journey​ is a pixel-art action RPG set in a fully hand-drawn world, where players embark on an adventure-driven journey. Combat is the core gameplay experience—players must master ​perfect blocks, perfect dodges, perfect counters, and a ​charged "Instant Slash" attack​ to effectively weaken enemies. Different foes require strategic adaptation, forcing players to choose the optimal offensive or defensive approach in each encounter.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459880/FantasyJourney/

Developer: XiangziArtStudio 
X: https://x.com/Xiangzi202599

#indiegame #pixelart #actionrpg
